study type: Prospective observational study with a control group
exposure: duration of uterine torsion (6-12 hours, 12-24 hours, 24-48 hours, >48 hours)
cohort: The study included 24 full-term pregnant buffaloes affected with uterine torsion, divided into four groups based on torsion duration, and 6 normal full-term pregnant buffaloes as a control group.
finding: Serum biochemical parameters (glucose, total protein, albumin, BUN, creatinine, CPK, AST) and cortisol concentration vary significantly with the duration of uterine torsion and are useful in predicting its prognosis in buffaloes.
